topic.title: Runtime errors and the error hook

body.p: When a run-time error occurs, the compiler records it in shared cells and, if the program defines procedure _error_hook(), calls it at the point of failure. No parameters and no registration: the name is the opt-in. With no hook there is no call overhead, and the cells stay set for polling.

section.title: The error cells
section.p: _error_source names the subsystem that raised the error, and the matching domain cell holds the code:
section.codeblock: _error_source = _ERROR_SOURCE_STRING -- _string_error holds the code (1) _error_source = _ERROR_SOURCE_USER -- application-raised (2) _error_source = _ERROR_SOURCE_CORE -- _core_error holds the code (3)
section.p: _string_error records the result of the most recent string operation. Reading it returns the stored code and resets it to none, so read it once per operation:
section.codeblock: _string_error_none 0 _string_error_heap_full 1 -- no heap space for the operation _string_error_overflow 2 -- a fixed string was truncated _string_error_invalid 3 -- a string argument was invalid _string_error_range 4 -- a value was outside its range
section.p: _core_error records the core-pin error on multi-core targets: _core_error_none (0) and _core_error_range (1) for a core(...) value outside 0..N.

section.title: Defining the hook
section.codeblock: procedure _error_hook() is var byte err if _error_source == _ERROR_SOURCE_STRING then err = _string_error -- read ONCE: the read clears it if err == _STRING_ERROR_HEAP_FULL then -- handle heap full end if end if end procedure
section.p: The cells are consume-on-read: read each into a variable once and compare that. The hook clears the cells when it returns.

section.title: The ready-made handler
section.p: INCLUDE error_hook installs a handler that reports every error the compiler can raise. Tailor it with two optional aliases declared before the include: ALIAS _error_bit IS <bit> latches a flag, and ALIAS _error_device IS <device> selects where the error is printed.
section.codeblock: include print alias _error_device is serial_data alias _error_bit is led include error_hook
